{{Short description|Russian scientist}}
'''Alexandr Nikolayevich Shiplyuk''' ({{langx|ru|Александр Николаевич Шиплюк}}) is a Russian scientist, Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences, corresponding member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]], a specialist in the field of gas dynamics. According to ''[[Kommersant]]'', he is an expert of the scientific and technical council of the military-industrial commission, the Section of Hypersonic Weapons under the Government of the Russian Federation.<ref name="komm">{{Cite web |title=Директор Института теоретической и прикладной механики РАН Шиплюк арестован за госизмену – Коммерсантъ |trans-title=Director of the Institute of Theoretical and Applied Mechanics of the Russian Academy of Sciences Shiplyuk arrested for treason – Kommersant |url=https://www.kommersant.ru/amp/5501207 |access-date=2024-05-22 |website=www.kommersant.ru}}</ref>

==Biography==
Alexandr Shiplyuk was born on September 8, 1966, in [[Barabinsk]], [[Novosibirsk Oblast]]. He graduated from [[Secondary school|middle school]] No. 93 in his hometown.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.itam.nsc.ru/structure/administration/shiplyuk.html |title=Шиплюк Александр Николаевич |trans-title=Shiplyuk Alexander Nikolaevich |website=ITAM SB RAS |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221208134627/http://www.itam.nsc.ru/structure/administration/shiplyuk.html |archive-date=8 December 2022 |access-date=25 May 2023 |url-status=live}}</ref>

In 1990, Shiplyuk graduated from the [[Novosibirsk State Technical University|Novosibirsk Electrotechnical Institute]] (NETI) with a degree hydroaerodynamics and received the qualification of an aerohydromechanical engineer.<ref name="archras">{{Cite web |title=Шиплюк Александр Николаевич. {{!}} ИС АРАН |trans-title=Shiplyuk Alexander Nikolaevich |url=https://isaran.ru/?guid=19B5A709-C036-D845-9A01-AC3551A3357F&q=ru/person |access-date=2024-05-22 |website=isaran.ru}}</ref>

Since 1990, he has worked at the [[Khristianovich Institute of Theoretical and Applied Mechanics]] (ITAM) as a trainee researcher, junior researcher, researcher, senior researcher, leading researcher, head of the laboratory of hypersonic technologies, deputy director of the institute.<ref name="archras"/>

In 2005, Shiplyuk defended his doctoral dissertation on the subject ''Development of Disturbances and Control of Boundary Layers at Hypersonic Velocities'' (''Развитие возмущений и управление пограничными слоями при гиперзвуковых скоростях'').<ref name="archras"/>

Since 2007, he has been delivering the following lectures at the Department of Aerohydrodynamics of the Novosibirsk State Technical University: ''Methods of Aerophysical Experiment'' (annual course), semester courses of lectures ''Methods of Optimization in Problems of Ballistics and Aerodynamics'' and ''Modern Problems of Ballistics and Hydroaerodynamics''.<ref name="komm"/>

In 2012, he was elected a [[corresponding member]] of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] in the {{Interlanguage link|Department of Energy, Mechanical Engineering, Mechanics and Control Processes|ru|3=Отделение энергетики, машиностроения, механики и процессов управления РАН}}.<ref name="archras"/>

In 2015, he became the director of ITAM.<ref name="komm"/>

''Kommersant'' and [[TASS]] report that the scientist is the head of Laboratory No.5 called ''The Hypersonic Technologies'' (''Гиперзвуковые технологии'').<ref name="komm"/><ref name="tass">{{cite news |url=https://tass.ru/proisshestviya/15404983 |title=Директора института СО РАН Александра Шиплюка арестовали по делу о госизмене |trans-title=Director of the Institute of the SB RAS Alexander Shiplyuk was arrested in the case of treason |agency=TASS |date=5 August 2022 |access-date=}}</ref>  However, according to the ITAM website, the laboratory is called ''The Aerogasdynamics of High Velocities'' (''Аэрогазодинамика больших скоростей''), and the institute’s website also indicates that the scientist became its head in 2006.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Лаб. 5. Гиперзвуковых технологий |trans-title=Lab. 5. Hypersonic technologies |url=http://www.itam.nsc.ru/structure/labs/lab_5/index.html |date= |access-date=2024-05-22 |website=www.itam.nsc.ru}}</ref>

===Suspicion of state treason and arrest===
On August 5, 2022, TASS reported that the scientist was arrested in a case of state treason, and the news agency also mentioned that the Institute of Theoretical and Applied Mechanics was searched.<ref name="tass"/> Reuters reported that Russia accused Shiplyuk for passing classified material at a scientific conference in China in 2017 as reason for the arrest. Shiplyuk claims that the classified material was freely accessible on the Internet.<ref>{{cite news |first1=Filipp |last1=Lebedev |first2=Lucy |last2=Papachristou |first3=Mark |last3=Trevelyan |date=24 May 2023 |title=Exclusive: Russian hypersonic scientist accused of betraying secrets to China |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/russian-hypersonic-scientist-accused-betraying-secrets-china-sources-2023-05-24/ |agency=Reuters |access-date=}}</ref>

==Scientific activity==
The main scientific activity of Shiplyuk is the development of the experimental base and methods of aerophysical research, as well as the experimental aerothermodynamics of hypersonic aircraft with ramjet engines.<ref name="tass"/>

Among the developments of the scientist are the modernization and creation of equipment for ground tests, methods for modeling wave processes in hypersonic shear flows; revealing nonlinear mechanisms of laminar-turbulent transition in hypersonic boundary layers; experimental discovery of a new method for stabilizing hypersonic boundary layers using coatings with a porous microstructure that absorb ultrasound; creation of a new type of thermoanemometric sensor with a sensitive element in the form of a semiconductor single-crystal micro- or nanotube.<ref name="archras"/>

==Awards==
Alexandr Shiplyuk was awarded the Academician Struminsky Prize for works in the field of aerodynamics among young scientists of the [[Siberian Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences|SB RAS]], he is also the winner of the youth competition of scientific works of the Novosibirsk Scientific Center of the Siberian Branch of the RAS, dedicated to the 275th anniversary of the RAS.<ref name="archras"/>
